name: VG Wort
description: Integrates VG Wort (German reproduction-rights society) counting into content using publisher keys.
project_description:
Integrate German VG Wort service for Drupal.

 The new module uses publisher defined keys to send tracking information to VG Wort. The Metis module obtains keys form VG Wort. We created a new module due to this different approach.

 Version 2.0 and 3.0 allow you to add the 1x1 image to content using a computed base field. It will also allow you to send author information to VG Wort for your content.

 Future plans include using other features of the VG Wort API to improve the information available to both Drupal and VG Wort.

 The Drupal 7 module was built by Erik Seifert and is obsolete and unsupported.
